title: Simple 3-joint robot arm (default pose) (Python (trimesh + numpy))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Python (trimesh + numpy) that procedurally generates: Assemble a robot arm from a chain of primitive segments -- a base cylinder, followed by two box 'link' segments connected by cylindrical 'joint' sleeves at each connection point -- positioned in a plausible bent default pose (not a flat line). Segment lengths/radii must be CLI-configurable; all segments must be merged into a single exported mesh. Save to glb, obj with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
